svg.title: MVEP Component Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: A structural diagram showing the Multi-Vendor E-Commerce Platform's component hierarchy across three layers: routing/auth, vendor dashboard, and customer storefront, with a shared state and UI layer at the bottom.
